name: motion-drawer
title: Motion Drawer
description: An off-canvas navigation drawer that springs in from the left with a link list and one upgrade button. It closes from its X, the dimmed overlay, or a sideways drag.
use: A compact nav or filter panel should slide over the page with a physical feel.
avoid: Panel width is a fixed pixel value and the 60px top padding cannot be changed by prop.
a11y: The icon-only open and close buttons have no accessible names, and Escape is not handled. (keyboard: yes, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark panel slides over the page from the left, about 280px wide, with a small Menu heading, four stacked link rows and a white Upgrade Plan button at the bottom. Behind it the page title Motion Drawer and its hint stay visible on black.
behaves: A menu icon at the top left opens a spring-driven dark panel from the left while a light overlay dims the page; the X, an overlay click or a sideways drag closes it. Links tint on hover.
customise: width, direction, colours, overlay, spring config, drag and toggle behaviour are props; the links and Upgrade Plan are your children.
weight: light: One drawer, one overlay and a small menu; nothing loops.
